svg.aria-label: Example: G(s) = 4/((s + 1)(s/2 + 1)(s/3 + 1)). Three ways to fit the circle criterion. The disk of radius 4 about the origin gives the sector [−0.25, 0.25]. A disk centred at 1.5 with radius 2.9 gives [−0.227, 0.714]. The vertical line Re = −0.859, just left of the plot, gives [0, 1.164]
svg.title: Example: G(s) = 4/((s + 1)(s/2 + 1)(s/3 + 1)). Three ways to fit the circle criterion. The disk of radius 4 about the origin gives the sector [−0.25, 0.25]. g.text: orange: disk with centre 1.5 and radius 2.9 gives the sector [−0.227, 0.714]
pink: the line Re = −0.859 gives the sector [0, 1.164]
